top_violation_types.title: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Number of Unrelated Children Never Exceeds 3 (26 TAC §742.307(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver had 9 unrelated children in her care on a regular basis for compensation.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §746.1107(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver is still missing education requirements.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks (26 TAC §746.301(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the operation was licensed with 15 toilets and 8 sinks and at the time of the inspection only had 10 toilets and 5 sinks that were working and available for children use.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The center director has been unable to meet director responsibility requirements. Repeated deficiencies in the areas of background checks and fire safety have occurred.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.
